Sam.Sales: POC kickoff with AuroraBank tomorrow 10am PT. They sent a security questionnaire + a big list: SAML attr limits, SCIM delta semantics, RBAC mapping, domain proofing, and provisioning throughput. Need concise answers.
Maria.Solutions: Core asks noted. I'll gather sample assertion + CSV for demo.
Raj.SE: SCIM short answer: hosted rate limit ~600 reqs/min per token, deltas via meta.lastModified, use pagination startIndex+count, recommend delta every 5m for normal loads.
Cody.Engineering: SAML note: keep assertions <16KB if possible; for >200 groups send group IDs (group_refs) instead of full lists to avoid parsing issues.
Nina.Security: Hosted does not support customer-managed HSM. Private supports BYOK/HSM. Audit logs retained 90d by default; extended retention available as enterprise add-on.
Sam.Sales: They ask whether 400k initial users + 15k daily deltas requires Dedicated. Quick take?
Cody.Engineering: For sustained high provisioning, recommend Dedicated for predictable throughput. Hosted can handle bulk but will be rate-limited and slower.
Maria.Solutions: POC plan: 1) Request sample SAML assertion (redact) 2) DNS TXT for domain proofing 3) 10k CSV sample import for mapping demo 4) short security snippet from Nina.
OpsBot: Demo env ready: aurora-demo-2026 (expires in 14 days).
Raj.SE: Add to guidance: advise NTP-synced clocks to avoid meta.lastModified skew; use exponential backoff + Retry-After on 429.
Nina.Security: I'll post exact questionnaire text in 30m for copy/paste.
Sam.Sales: Please drop drafts here EOD. Need final before 9am kickoff. :thumbsup:
